reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
I bought AirPods Pro 3 from noon. When I started using them, the sound was distorted, and I couldn't add them to Find My.

I requested a return, but noon rejected it, saying the item I sent back isn't the item they delivered. When I asked for the reason, I was told it looks fake.

I photographed the serial number when the order arrived, and it matches the serial number of the item I returned. So the item I returned is exactly what noon delivered to me.

That means noon sold me a product that its own team considers fake. I bought it directly from noon and didn't swap anything. Instead of taking responsibility, noon rejected my return.

I'm asking for a full refund, and for noon to explain how a product it considers fake was sold and delivered to me.

reviews.title: horrible experience and unacceptable customer service
reviews.text:
I purchased an AED 369 PSN voucher as a gift for a celebration. When the recipient tried to redeem it, PlayStation showed that the code had already been used. I had evidence supporting my complaint from the beginning, yet it took Noon around two weeks to resolve the issue.

I contacted customer service repeatedly and kept receiving essentially the same response: the matter was with the “concerned team” and I had to continue waiting. I was also given resolution timeframes that passed without the issue being resolved.

The delay had a real consequence. I had purchased the voucher specifically to buy a PlayStation offer available at the time. By the time Noon dealt with the problem, that offer was gone, so simply returning the original purchase amount did not put me back in the position I expected to be in when I made the purchase.

After all the calls, waiting, missed timeframes, embarrassment of giving someone an already-redeemed gift, and approximately two weeks of chasing the issue, I received no additional compensation for the experience.

I was a frequent Noon customer and had a membership, but this experience and the way customer service handled it were bad enough that I cancelled my membership. I expected significantly better treatment of a loyal customer and much faster handling of such a straightforward, documented problem.

reviews.title: Noon minutes EGT
reviews.text:
I placed an order that was supposed to arrive within 6 minutes. After the order was confirmed, I received a call informing me that one of the items was unavailable and asking whether I wanted a replacement. I clearly stated that I did not want a replacement and was happy to receive the rest of the order without that item.

Shortly afterward, I received another call from a different representative regarding the same order, saying there was an issue and that they would inform the delivery rider. I then spoke again with the first representative, who assured me that my order would be delivered as agreed.

To my surprise, the order was later canceled without my consent, even though I had already confirmed that I wanted to proceed without the unavailable item.

When I contacted customer support to explain what happened, all I received was an apology. There was no meaningful solution, no compensation, and no clear explanation for why the order had been canceled.

What made the experience even more frustrating was being asked to report the missing item through the app, even though the order was never delivered in the first place. This was not a “missing item” issue—it was an order cancellation issue.

The communication between representatives was inconsistent, the order handling was poor, and the customer support response was extremely disappointing. Overall, this was one of the worst customer service experiences I have had.

reviews.title: Unacceptable Drivers attitude, and worst customer support ever
reviews.text:
This was one of the most frustrating delivery experiences I’ve had, especially during Suhoor time. I ordered specifically for Suhoor and was tracking the driver closely as he approached my location. I was waiting for the call the entire time, yet suddenly the order was marked as “not delivered.”

When I contacted customer support, they claimed the driver tried to reach me but couldn’t, which is simply not logical because I was actively waiting for the call while tracking the order. They then promised the driver would contact me within 10 minutes. After waiting more than 15 minutes with no call, I contacted support again and was told the issue would be resolved immediately within 2 minutes. Unfortunately, no one followed up and no action was taken.

What is even more disappointing is that the driver could have simply left the Suhoor order at the door instead of canceling it, especially considering the time and the purpose of the order. Because of this situation, I ended up missing Suhoor before fasting the next day, which makes the experience even more unacceptable.

In addition to this, I still have not received any refund or proper resolution, despite multiple contacts with support and repeated promises of action.

I expect this issue to be reviewed seriously, the driver’s behavior investigated, and a full refund or appropriate compensation provided. This level of service is far below what customers expect from Noon.
